text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp said Monday it received a $750,000 order for its INTRANET monitor product.
The name of the company which placed the order was not disclosed, but Wells-Gardner said it expects additional orders from it by the end of the year.
Wells-Gardner said it began shipping INTRANET, which is a personal computer and modem enclosed in a monitor, in April 1996. It said it expects sales of at least $1.5 million for the product in 1996.
It said it reported $400,000 in second quarter sales of INTRANET and had a backlog of about $300,000.
Wells-Gardner said it is also in discussions with other potential customers for similar INTRANET products which could boost sales and earnings further.
